_doc: Per-file quality_audit exclusion list (agents.md §1 max_indentation/max_lines_per_func). D1: skips these paths so refactoring vendored upstream code, which forks it on every future sync, is not forced. D2: an entry is added only after its file's provenance is verified byte-by-byte against Anthropic's upstream skill-creator (Apache-2.0, github.com/anthropics/skills, path skills/skill-creator/) at commit 3d59511518591fa82e6cfcf0438d68dd5dad3e76 (chore: export latest skills (#465)). Stale-entry rule: quality_audit.py exits 2 when an entry's path no longer exists in the tree, so this list cannot silently outlive the files it names.
